When Tyler James Williams—best known for his childhood starring role in Everybody Hates Chris—stopped by Sway in the Morning on Sway’s Universe, he surprised many skeptics by stepping outside his comfort zone and handling a high-profile freestyle. Tackling instrumental beats like Drake’s “6 God”, Williams delivered a structured verse featuring multi-syllabic rhyme schemes that challenged the traditional perception of him strictly as a comedic or dramatic television actor. The appearance quickly turned into a viral internet moment, proving his unexpected lyrical capabilities on the mic.
